purpose: make the system allow each action only to those entitled to take it, checked on the server every time
entry_criteria: Roles, permissions and data ownership rules are defined
Test users with different roles exist
procedure: Define roles and permissions from the business rules, using least privilege and separate duties for risky actions.
Check authorization on the server for every operation and every object, not only in the user interface.
Check that the user owns or may access the specific record, not only that they have the role.
Deny by default: new routes and operations have no access until a rule is added.
Log access decisions for sensitive actions, and provide a way to review who can do what.
Test with a matrix of roles against operations, including attempts to reach another user's records.
acceptance_criteria: Every operation is checked on the server

validation.command: pytest -q tests/authz   # example matrix of role against operation
validation.expect: all expected allows and denies pass

validation.check: as user A request user B's record by changing the id in the URL

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A test matrix tries each role against each operation. It finds that a support role can export all invoices, which should be limited to the customer in the open ticket; the check is added and the test recorded.
